title: Blind Spot Information System — Component Locations
introduction:
I read this drawing from the car outward: find a highlighted location on the transparent body, follow its leader line to the enlarged inset, then match the inset’s callout to the table. The drawing does the X-ray work for us, showing components that bodywork would normally hide.

The mirror inset points to the exterior mirror locations; the rectangular module inset points to the rear corners of the vehicle. Read the paired module abbreviations in the table, in order, as side obstacle detection control module LH and side obstacle detection control module RH. LH means left-hand; RH means right-hand.

Use this page to identify components and their general locations. It provides no trim-removal route, connector pinout or diagnostic test.
